The Chinese characters for Donald

As a transliteration, Donald is usually written 唐纳德 (Táng nà dé). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

唐
Táng
the Tang dynasty
纳
nà
receive, accept
德
dé
virtue, morality

Origin and meaning

From Scottish, Donald carries the meaning “world ruler”.

About the name Donald

A Gaelic name meaning 'world ruler', long associated with Scottish clans.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Donald as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “world ruler”, is part of the appeal.
